name: @epoch/developer-portal-host
description: Epoch Developer Portal HOST (W025, service layer) — the thin typed runtime facade for Developer Portal/Publishing: capability browsing over the REAL W007 registry (deterministic filtered listings + version-constrained resolution — the registry stays the authority), listing authoring/publishing sessions over the REAL W023 marketplace kernel admission (draft probe validation, sealed content-addressed immutable listing versions, hash chains, dangling-reference rejection, idempotent publication with typed version-conflict on mutation), developer analytics adoption of W023 entitlement grant/revocation records, W023 developer revenue records, and the W024 sealed billing account (all verified through the REAL upstream validators; idempotent with typed idempotency-conflict), a deterministic developer dashboard projection (active entitlements via the REAL marketplace check, revenue folds per currency, payout account), tenant-scoped reads (R12), and health/liveness as typed data. Every operation sits behind the W009 authorization gate (fail-closed) and every lifecycle step emits portal:* events over the W010 event shapes (one stream per listing, one developer stream per tenant; digests sealed in-package and parity-pinned against the REAL W010 sealEvent via devDependency tests). Declaration-only public contract tree under contracts/ (index.d.ts + manifest.json + parity.ts + schemas/, NO package.json — the W012 convention). NO persistence, NO network, NO wall-clock, NO randomness — every instant is caller-supplied.
